annotation.title_clean: Bekendtgørelse om supplerende bestemmelser til EU-forordning 2019/947 om regler og procedurer for operation af ubemandede luftfartøjer
annotation.title_en: Executive Order on supplementary provisions to EU Regulation 2019/947 on rules and procedures for the operation of unmanned aircraft
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Trafik-, Bygge- og Boligstyrelsen (Danish Transport, Construction and Housing Authority)
annotation.summary_en: Danish executive order of 29 December 2020 supplementing EU drone Regulation 2019/947. It sets mandatory liability insurance, remote pilot age limits, no-fly distances around airfields, military and security sites, infrastructure and homes, geographic drone zones, transitional rules and fines, effective 1 January 2021.
key_provisions_or_claims: Drone flights require liability insurance of at least 0.75 million SDR, with exemptions such as C0 drones.
Remote pilots must be at least 15 in the open and specific categories.
Minimum distances apply to helicopter sites, airfields, military areas, royal residences, railways, roads and power lines.
Flying over homes and gardens requires owner consent, which protects privacy.
Violations are punishable by fines, including corporate criminal liability; effective 1 January 2021.
